title: 2013 AMC 10A Problem 12
statement: In \(\triangle ABC,\) \(AB=AC=28\) and \(BC=20.\) Points \(D,\) \(E,\) and \(F\) are on sides \(\overline{AB},\) \(\overline{BC},\) and \(\overline{AC},\) respectively, such that \(\overline{DE}\) and \(\overline{EF}\) are parallel to \(\overline{AC}\) and \(\overline{AB},\) respectively. What is the perimeter of parallelogram \(ADEF?\)

solutions.text:
Note that \(\triangle DBE \sim \triangle ABC\) and \(\triangle FEC \sim \triangle ABC\) due to the parallel lines.

This tells us that \(DB = DE\) and \(FE = FC.\) We have that the perimeter of \(ADEF\) is \[ AD + DE + EF + AF \]\[= AD + DB + FC + AF \] \[ = AB + AC \]\[= 56. \]

Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: Use the parallels to get similar triangles near \(B\) and \(C\)
Rewrite opposite sides of the parallelogram as pieces of \(AB\) and \(AC\)
